original_ai_output.title_zh: 突尼斯总统在人权组织批评后放宽“假新闻”法令
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 突尼斯总统凯斯·赛义德周三放宽了一项广受人权组织批评的网络犯罪法令，取消了针对传播“假新闻”的五年监禁刑罚。该法令自2022年起实施，人权组织称其被用于起诉异见声音。原法令规定，利用信息通信系统传播“假新闻”或谣言最高可判五年监禁并处罚金。

key_facts.fact: 突尼斯总统赛义德放宽了网络犯罪法令，取消传播“假新闻”的五年监禁刑罚
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Tunisian President Kais Saied on Wednesday softened a cybercrime decree that was widely criticised by rights groups, by scrapping a five-year prison sentence for the dissemination of "fake news".

key_facts.fact: 人权组织称该2022年法令被用于起诉异见声音
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Rights groups have regularly condemned the decree, which dates back to 2022, claiming that it has been used to prosecute dissenting voices.

key_facts.fact: 原法令规定传播“假新闻”最高可判五年监禁、罚款最高5万第纳尔（约1.7万美元），针对公职人员则升至十年
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The decree had provided for sentences of up to five years in prison and fines of up to 50,000 dinars ($17,000) for anyone using "information and communications systems and networks" to spread "fake news" or rumours, with the sentence rising to 10 years if the offence targeted a public official.

uncertainties: 该事件目前仅有一个来源（Africanews）报道，尚缺乏交叉验证
人权组织关于该法令被用于起诉异见声音的说法为声称，尚未经独立证实
